worldcombat.skill.iciclespear.summary: Breathe out a rank of ice crystals that fly straight at the target one after another: each hit deals physical damage and chills the target so it moves more slowly, and every shard frosts the ground where it lands. Almost no scatter and reliable; the rime choice slows harder and leaves more frost, but fires fewer icicles.
worldcombat.skill.iciclespear.use.0: The most reliable straight volley of icicles at long range
worldcombat.skill.iciclespear.use.1: Slow a target with chill while frosting the ground under it
worldcombat.skill.iciclespear.use.2: Use the shatter choice to pile single-icicle damage
worldcombat.skill.iciclespear.descriptio: Each icicle deals about %1$s physical damage, and one burst fires %2$s icicles.
Icicles fire every %1$s at %2$s blocks/tick, reaching %3$s blocks with up to ±%4$s spread.

Each icicle has a %1$s block hit radius; a hit leaves the target chilled for %2$s, slowing its movement (about 15%% for the shatter form, 30%% for the rime form) and refreshing on every further icicle; whether it hits or misses, the landing frosts the ground within %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.iciclespear.rime.on: Rime: each hit's chill is one slow tier higher, chill duration x1.6, frost radius x1.3 and spread x0.8; costs icicles capped at 3, interval +1 tick, per-icicle power x0.9, wind-up +2 ticks and cooldown +4 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.iciclespear.rime.off: Shatter: up to 5 icicles, per-icicle power x1.1 and cooldown -4 ticks; costs the shallowest chill (weakest slow), a smaller frost patch, and a wider spread x1.1.
worldcombat.skill.iciclespear.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.iciclespear.growth.0: From level %1$s the per-icicle power rises to %2$s and the burst grows to %3$s icicles.
worldcombat.skill.iciclespear.growth.1: From level %1$s the per-icicle power rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.iciclespear.preference: On: each hit's chill is one slow tier higher, chill duration x1.6, frost radius x1.3 and spread x0.8, good for pinning a target and frosting ground; costs icicles capped at 3, interval +1 tick, per-icicle power x0.9, wind-up +2 ticks and cooldown +4 ticks. Off (shatter): up to 5 icicles, per-icicle power x1.1 and cooldown -4 ticks, at the cost of the shallowest chill, a smaller frost patch and a wider spread.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: low-health targets rank higher so the burst finishes them; off: all targets score the same.
